mapper.sql: CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(al.factory_scope), '') IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(al.factory_scope) WHEN al.resource_type='factory_warehouse_mapping' AND al.resource_id<>'IMPORT' THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(al.resource_id, '|', 1) WHEN al.resource_type='mrp_factory' AND al.resource_id<>'IMPORT' THEN al.resource_id WHEN al.resource_type='mrp_production_calendar' AND LOCATE('|', al.resource_id)>1 THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(al.resource_id, '|', 1) ELSE NULL END

WHERE #{userId} IS NOT NULL AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN role_data_scope ds ON ds.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND ds.scope_type='ALL') OR (al.resource_type IN ('USER','ROLE','PERMISSION','material_policy','business_week') AND NULLIF(TRIM(al.factory_scope),'') IS NULL) OR ( ()<>'ALL' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_factory_scope ufs WHERE ufs.user_id=#{userId} AND ufs.factory_code=()) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN role_data_scope ds ON ds.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND ds.scope_type='FACTORY' AND ds.scope_value=()) ) ) OR (al.factory_scope='ALL' AND al.resource_type IN ('forecast_draft','forecast_version') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_factory f WHERE f.enabled=1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mrp_factory f WHERE f.enabled=1 AND NOT ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_factory_scope ufs WHERE ufs.user_id=#{userId} AND ufs.factory_code=f.factory_code) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN role_data_scope ds ON ds.role_id=r.id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND ds.scope_type='FACTORY' AND ds.scope_value=f.factory_code)))) )
AND (al.resource_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{filters.keyword},'%') OR al.operator_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{filters.keyword},'%'))
AND al.action=#{filters.action} AND al.resource_type=#{filters.resourceType} AND al.resource_type IN ('forecast_line','forecast_draft','forecast_version') AND al.resource_id=#{filters.resourceId} AND al.created_at>=#{filters.startDate} AND al.created_at<=CONCAT(#{filters.endDate},' 23:59:59')
mapper.select:
SELECT al.id, al.operator_id, al.operator_role, al.factory_scope, al.action, al.resource_type, al.resource_id, al.before_value, al.after_value, al.trace_id, al.ip_address, al.created_at, u.display_name AS operator_name, u.avatar_url AS operator_avatar_url FROM audit_log al LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id=al.operator_id
ORDER BY al.created_at DESC, al.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
